tokens.name: nv-10

tokens.name: nv-14

tokens.name: nv-18

tokens.name: nv-28

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Brand blue, the nominal colour of the mark and the first stop of the logo gradient. Never a surface in the shell; the scrollbar thumb on hover.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: The fill of the screen's one primary action (`Button` primary, 5.9:1 with `on-brand`). The only chromatic area on a shell screen.

tokens.name: brand-lift
tokens.usage: The focus ring only (`focus`): 2px solid, offset 2px. Visible on every surface, the one exception to the single-voice rule.

tokens.name: sig
tokens.usage: Tally carmine: the ON AIR signal. The program frame while live, the LIVE pill, the danger button (5.02:1 with `on-sig`). Never in charts, warnings, field errors or decoration.

tokens.name: sig-deep
tokens.usage: Carmine as text on light grounds (`sig-texto` in the light theme): destructive menu items.

tokens.name: sig-lift
tokens.usage: Carmine as text on dark and console grounds (`sig-texto`): destructive menu items, the error toast icon.

tokens.name: brand-grad-from
tokens.usage: Logo gradient, start (Y 22.9%). Lives only inside the logo mark and wordmark.

tokens.name: brand-grad-mid
tokens.usage: Logo gradient, middle (Y 23.0%): isoluminant with both ends, so the gradient is a pure hue rotation. Only inside the logo.

tokens.name: brand-grad-to
tokens.usage: Logo gradient, end (Y 22.9%). Only inside the logo.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Form field fill and any sunken well: inputs, the tray control when off, the audio meter track.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page and app header background. Body copy `ink` reads on it at 11.6:1 (dark), 12.0:1 (light), 13.4:1 (console).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the studio bar and tray, the scrollbar track, the chat composer.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Loading skeleton, switch track when off, menu item hover, master-list row hover, scene row hover, the next-cut box, the current destination in the mobile menu.

tokens.name: raise
tokens.usage: One step up: ghost/icon/chip hover, the active segment, the chosen master row, the scene in preview, the pressed tray control, the open tool tab, the menu popover, toasts.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Every 1px structural rule: section tops, list dividers, header and tray borders, the master-detail divider, the next-cut box border.

tokens.name: line-ctl
tokens.usage: Control borders: ghost button, chip, segmented, field, tray control, slider track. Known debt from the source: 1.4 to 2.3:1 against the surfaces, under WCAG 1.4.11's 3:1; the field is read by its `well` fill and label.

tokens.name: ink-hi
tokens.usage: Titles, names, the current destination, switch on, checked box fill, pending states, field errors (phrase and border), the meter near the limit, the on-air elapsed time. Reads on `bg`, `surface`, `panel`, `raise`, `well` at 13:1 or more in every theme.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy; the time in mono; ghost button text; chat text. On `bg`/`surface`/`panel`/`raise`: 9.6:1 or more in every theme.

tokens.name: ink-lo
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, field hints, text actions at rest, non-current destinations, monitor scene names, meter readings. On `bg`/`surface`/`panel`/`raise`: 6.6:1 (dark), 7.9:1 (light), 5.8:1 (console) or better.

tokens.name: ink-dim
tokens.usage: Placeholder text and the unchecked checkbox border (3:1 against every surface, gated in CI). On `raise` in dark: 4.5:1 exactly; never smaller than 12px.

tokens.name: sig-texto
tokens.usage: Destructive actions as text: 'Remover canal', 'Excluir webinar', 'Encerrar transmissão' in a menu. 5.3:1 on dark `raise`, 6.4:1 on light `raise`.

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: The video letterbox behind every monitor and the stage itself. Never lightens, in any theme.

tokens.name: guia
tokens.usage: Thirds, safe-area and centre guides drawn over the monitor image in `mix-blend-mode: difference`: visible on light or dark picture, no colour of their own.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The dimmed backdrop behind a dialog, with a 2px blur.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `brand-deep` fill (the primary button). 5.9:1.

tokens.name: on-sig
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `sig` fill: the danger button, the LIVE pill. 5.02:1.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring: `outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 4px`. 3.3:1 on light `bg`, 5.5:1 on dark `bg`, 6.1:1 on console `bg`.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart grid lines.

tokens.name: chart-axis
tokens.usage: Chart axes. Tick labels are set in `ink-lo`, never in this colour.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First series (the headline: viewers, bitrate). Series are separated by VALUE on the ramp, never by hue: the order survives protanopia, deuteranopia and greyscale.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second series.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third series.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth series.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth series; also the unfilled part of a usage meter.

tokens.name: g-fundo
tokens.usage: Stage graphics plate: the banner, ticker, timer and pinned-comment background ON THE PICTURE. These are the live's colours, not the console's; identical in every theme.

tokens.name: g-texto
tokens.usage: Stage graphics text on `g-fundo` (16.4:1).

tokens.name: g-texto-2
tokens.usage: Stage graphics secondary text: the comment author, the timer title (12.3:1 on `g-fundo`).

tokens.name: g-qr
tokens.usage: The QR code card on the stage: white, which phones read best; its ink is `g-qr-ink`.

tokens.name: g-qr-ink
tokens.usage: Ink of the QR code card.

families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen: the page h1, the next live's title on the Painel, the public home h1. `text-balance`.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section h2, dialog title, the detail-panel header (icon + platform name), the on-air session name in the studio bar.

styles.name: abertura
styles.sample: Transmita para todos os canais de uma vez, direto do navegador.
styles.usage: The one sentence under a page or home h1, in `ink-lo`, `max-width: 65ch`.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A assinatura abre em breve, por aqui mesmo. Hoje nenhuma cobrança é feita.
styles.usage: Descriptions, chip and button labels, chat text, list secondary lines. The shell's working size.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Names in list rows, field labels (in `ink-hi`), the plan name, the chat author.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: The metadata line under a name, the state word in a master list, field hints and errors, the footer, monitor labels, tool-tab captions.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Money is not an instrument: Poppins, with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` so plan rows read in a column. Always through the app's BRL formatter.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Default `Button`, the transition keys, the tray controls.

styles.name: button-lg
styles.usage: The screen's action only: 'Entrar no estúdio', 'Criar conta', 'Ir ao ar'.

styles.name: button-sm
styles.usage: Dense surfaces: the studio bar, billing tables, list-row ghost buttons.

styles.name: measure
styles.usage: Every live number, and only the number: the meter reading, transition durations, chat timestamps, bitrate, dropped frames, latency. Always `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`; never a label or ornament.

styles.name: measure-md
styles.usage: The camera card readout while adjusting, the hour inside a schedule label, a destination's bitrate in a health row.

styles.name: measure-lg
styles.usage: The on-air elapsed clock and the headline of a stat tile. Tabular.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark beside the mark: 'Pw' in `ink-hi`, 'Streamer' clipped to the brand gradient; monochrome in the console. Part of the logo, not a text style for UI.

styles.name: wordmark-tag
styles.usage: The tagline under the wordmark, uppercase, in `ink-lo`. Part of the mark; the only uppercase tracked text in the system and not a model for labels.

spacing.note: Named by what they separate, as the shell is built. A 4px base underlies them.

tokens.name: hairline-gap
tokens.usage: Value under a registry label; menu padding; the gap between a checkbox and its label line.

tokens.name: chip-gap
tokens.usage: Between chips in a wrapping row; label-to-field; a description under a title; the gap inside a button between icon and label; the gap between a dialog's footer buttons is 10px.

tokens.name: field-inset
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding inside a field; the gap between two short fields side by side (Data and Hora).

tokens.name: row-y
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a list row; the gutter at narrow widths; the gap between the monitors on the desk; the gap from a section header to its content.

tokens.name: field-gap
tokens.usage: Between form fields; between a section title's text actions; between the dialog's panel and its sides (px-5).

tokens.name: section-inset
tokens.usage: From a section's top rule to its title; the wide gutter; the master-detail gap from the divider to the detail.

tokens.name: action-gap
tokens.usage: From the live's title to the screen's action on the Painel.

tokens.name: section-gap
tokens.usage: Between sections; the page top at narrow widths; from a page header to a registry.

tokens.name: page-top-wide
tokens.usage: Page top from the `sm` breakpoint.

tokens.name: page-bottom
tokens.usage: Page bottom padding.

radius.note: Controls are rounded; structure and anything that shows picture or measure is square.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Monitors (the tally frame), the next-cut box, the audio meter track, stage graphics, the capture frame of the home: a desk is square.

tokens.name: radius-focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring's corner.

tokens.name: radius-check
tokens.usage: The 20px checkbox: the only control under the scale, so it never reads as a radio.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Menu trigger, toast close button.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The dense `sm` button; the inner segment of a segmented control; the corner-picker cell.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Menu items; the outline inside the home capture.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Buttons, icon buttons, fields, the segmented outer, the menu popover, scene rows, transition keys, tray controls, tool tabs, master rows, the 40px platform tile, the camera card.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the stage inside a monitor (the frame follows it +2px).

tokens.name: radius-3xl
tokens.usage: Reserved by the scale; unused in the shell today.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, switches, the slider thumb, the LIVE pill, the current-destination underline.

shadow.note: The floor is flat. A shadow exists only on what floats and disappears when it closes.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: The anchored `Menu` popover (actions, the account menu, the device picker in the tray).

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Dialogs, confirmations and toasts; the camera card over the stage.

tokens.name: shadow-veil
tokens.usage: Not depth: the darkening around the hovered region of the home's Painel capture, clipped by its frame; 0% opacity at rest.

size.note: Fixed measures the components are cut to.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every structural rule and control border.

tokens.name: tally-ring
tokens.usage: The monitor frame's ring: it FRAMES (the stage's padding). Carmine while on air, `n-89` on the preview, `n-14` on the program at rest.

tokens.name: tally-mark
tokens.usage: The thickness of the eight corner marks that SIGNAL on air, drawn 10px outside the frame in `n-92`; arms 13% wide and 22% tall. Neutral, so identical under protanopia and in greyscale (6.8:1 under blur).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Focus outline width; offset 2px.

tokens.name: touch
tokens.usage: The minimum target: icon buttons, fields, tray controls, the checkbox row, text actions in a list row.

tokens.name: header

tokens.name: studio-bar

tokens.name: chip

tokens.name: switch-w
tokens.usage: Switch width; height 24px; thumb 16px.

tokens.name: checkbox
tokens.usage: Checkbox side.

tokens.name: meter-h
tokens.usage: Audio meter height; width 96px (64px on phones); segments every 6px with a 1px gap in `surface`.

tokens.name: column
tokens.usage: The shell's single content column.

tokens.name: header-max
tokens.usage: Header and footer width: the column sits inset from the bar.

tokens.name: modal-md
tokens.usage: Short-form dialog (Novo webinar).

tokens.name: modal-lg
tokens.usage: Single-column list dialog (plans).

tokens.name: modal-xl

tokens.name: tool-rail
tokens.usage: The studio's vertical tool-tab rail.

tokens.name: platform-tile
tokens.usage: The square frame around a platform icon on the Canais page, radius-xl, border `line`.

duration.note: Short for near, longer for far. One moment of motion per page; `prefers-reduced-motion` collapses all of it to a cut.

tokens.name: tap
tokens.usage: Button hover/active: only `filter` and `background-color` animate (GPU-composited, no relayout).

tokens.name: state
tokens.usage: Colour and transform changes of controls: switch thumb, segment, chip hover, menu item, the chevron of an action row (200ms).

tokens.name: enter
tokens.usage: Dialog and toast entry (fade + 95% zoom / slide from bottom 8px); the scrim fades in 150ms.

tokens.name: exit
tokens.usage: Dialog and toast exit.

tokens.name: confirm
tokens.usage: A success mark: scales 0.8 to 1.04 to 1 once and stops. Never a loop.

tokens.name: dissolve
tokens.usage: The Fusão: the outgoing program stays on top and fades. Printed inside the key in `measure` ('400 ms').

tokens.name: ticker
tokens.usage: One pass of the stage ticker; linear, infinite; stands still under reduced motion.

tokens.name: ease-enter
tokens.usage: Everything that enters or settles (out-expo).

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Everything that leaves.

tokens.name: ease-tap
tokens.usage: Button brightness and the ticker.
